# Contributing to Frankenstein RO

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Frankenstein RO.

This project exists as an experimental Ragnarok Online research project focused on learning, compatibility, scripting, server development and community collaboration.

Every contribution is appreciated.

---

# Before Contributing

Please make sure that your contribution is your own work or that you have the legal right to submit it.

By submitting any contribution to this repository, you confirm that:

* You are the author of the submitted content, **or**
* You have permission from the original author to redistribute it under a compatible license.

Do **not** submit content that violates copyrights, licenses, trademarks or intellectual property rights.

---

# Accepted Contributions

Examples include:

* Bug fixes
* Script improvements
* Documentation
* Translation improvements
* Compatibility fixes
* Code optimization
* Database improvements
* Configuration improvements
* Development tools
* Performance improvements

---

# Assets and Resources

Please do **not** submit:

* Official Ragnarok Online client files
* Proprietary game assets
* Commercial resources
* Files extracted from paid distributions
* Content whose origin cannot be verified

If a resource depends on official Ragnarok Online files, only submit the code or implementation required to support it.

---

# Translations

Translation improvements are welcome.

Whenever possible, please indicate:

* Original language
* Source project (if applicable)
* Original author (if known)

If you adapted an existing translation, please mention its original source.

---

# Pull Requests

When opening a Pull Request, please include:

* A brief description
* What problem it solves
* Any compatibility notes
* Credits for third-party work, if applicable

Small Pull Requests are preferred over very large ones.

---

# Responsibility of Contributors

By submitting code, documentation, translations, scripts or any other material to this repository, you declare that:

* You have the necessary rights to submit the material.
* Your contribution does not intentionally infringe third-party intellectual property rights.
* Any third-party content included in your submission has been properly identified whenever possible.

The contributor remains responsible for the legality and origin of the submitted material.

---

# Review Process

All contributions are reviewed before being accepted.

The project maintainer may:

* Request changes
* Reject submissions
* Modify contributions for compatibility
* Decline contributions without providing detailed justification

Submission of a Pull Request does not guarantee acceptance.

---

# Credits

Whenever possible, contributors will be credited for accepted work.

If any attribution is missing or incorrect, please open an Issue so it can be corrected.

---

Thank you for helping improve Frankenstein RO.
